description: Do what we can, to use space data to add values to the agriculture application. Whatever we can do, take it as experience to build upon for next steps.
details:
•Analyse water availability over time at farming areas.

•Generate continuously updating flood probability information (data and map) over the areas along Mekong River and Tonle Sap. The information can be updated when having data on storms and weather events such as El Nino.
